items.description: A world's declaration for one companion role: who drives a body that holds the role here, what it wears, and the authority its driver receives. A companion is admitted only where its role is declared; a crossing toward a world that declares nothing for its role is refused at reservation and the companion stays home.

name.description: The role's name, unique within the document (companion).

driver.description: The Name of this world's own addon that drives the role: the same pinned driver a visitor prefers, or one the author substitutes. Exactly one of this and Accept.

accept.description: Whether this world runs a visitor's own preferred driver, resolved by its pin from the process content store and verified before it mounts, under this world's Fuel and grants. One visiting driver runs per role; a companion preferring a different pin while one runs is refused at reservation.

kit.description: The Name an arriving companion moves under. Absent: the default peer kit. A companion re-adopted by its own home placement wears that placement's kit instead.

look.description: The Name an arriving companion wears. Absent: the default look.

fuel.description: The per-tick fuel a visiting driver runs under; 0 charges the ABI default. Ignored for a named Driver, whose own row states its fuel.

drive.description: The per-tick Drive budget the driver holds over each body of the role.

observe.description: The per-tick Observe budget the driver holds over each body of the role and over the body each follows.

followReach.description: How far from the door its player went through, in metres, a companion of the role leaving this world may start its own crossing: one that trailed further behind is set down this far from the door, so it arrives in sight of its player.

items.title: WorldRole
